title: EtaleResolutionSectionCanonicalRestriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $G$ an abelian etale sheaf, $I$ an injective resolution, and $c$ a comparison normalized on Ext cocycles [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. Then $c$ carries homology of section restriction from $X$ to each open $W$ to $\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(W\hookrightarrow X)$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], and restriction from $B$ to $A\subseteq B$ to $\operatorname{openCohomologyRestriction}(A\subseteq B)$, including its inverse-image composition transport [lem-weil-pbc-open-cohomology-whole-restriction-naturality]. Only these two restriction identities are asserted; no comparison is constructed and no arbitrary scheme transfer is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0A50, sections of an injective resolution; Tag 03F3 (2), localization; Read the corresponding Stacks tag pages; cocycle expansion of the parent proof, written by W3.

proof.text: Apply the whole-to-open restriction identity to G, I and c for the first conjunct and the open-to-open restriction identity to the same data for the second conjunct. Introduce the conjunction, without any change to coefficients, degrees or opens.

from.place: The resolution-section comparison: normalized Hom cocycles, their restriction, and their augmentation-preserving pullback transfer, below the Mayer-Vietoris comparison.

lean.statement: theorem resolutionSection_canonical_restriction {X : Scheme.{u}} (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (I : InjectiveResolution G) (c : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G I) : (∀ W q x, c.openEquiv W q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (etaleSectionMap (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk W.ι (Category.comp_id _) : Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) I.cocomplex) q x) = cohomologyMap W.ι G q (c.globalEquiv q x)) ∧ (∀ (A B : X.Opens) (h : A ≤ B) q x, c.openEquiv A q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (etaleSectionMap (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (X.homOfLE h) (X.homOfLE_ι _) : Scheme.Etale.mk A.ι ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk B.ι) I.cocomplex) q x) = openCohomologyRestriction h G q (c.openEquiv B q x))
